draft.shortGloss: to stand; to be able to afford
draft.emotion: still and quiet, holding a steady position without moving
notes: For 'to stand', the present tense is stoję, stoisz.
For 'to be able to afford', 'stać' is impersonal and does not conjugate (past: było stać). The person is in the accusative case, followed by 'na' + accusative (e.g. stać mnie na to).
